config.unpunchabletree.title: Unpunchable Tree
config.unpunchabletree.server_note: These settings apply to your singleplayer worlds and to LAN worlds you host. On a dedicated server, edit config/unpunchabletree.json on the server instead.
config.unpunchabletree.punchable_trees.t:
Logs and wood can be harvested by hand.
When disabled, they only drop when mined with an axe, and are as slow as stone to mine without one.
Dirt, sand, gravel and other shovel blocks can be harvested by hand.
When disabled, they only drop when mined with a shovel, and are as slow as stone to mine without one.
The Flint Hatchet can be thrown like a trident: hold right click, then release.
The other options of this tab only apply when this is enabled.
config.unpunchabletree.shield_over_throw: With a shield in the off hand, right click raises the shield instead of throwing the hatchet.
config.unpunchabletree.thrown_hatchet_du:
Durability a thrown hatchet loses when it hits an entity (a melee hit costs 2).
Unbreaking reduces it. Set it to 30 (the hatchet's durability) or more to make an unenchanted hatchet break on every hit.
